cadenas.es: Autónomo viable si empiezas solo, SL si hay socios
cadenas.propuesta_en: A sole proprietorship can work if you start alone; an LLC separates personal and business liability and suits partners. Ask your accountant about S or C corporations.
Form your LLC (articles of organization, registered agent, operating agreement)
Skip this step if you operate as a sole proprietor. Filing fees and processing times vary by state; write an operating agreement even for a single-member LLC.
Get your EIN (IRS) and register for state sales tax (seller's permit)

cadenas.es: Epígrafe IAE: 672.x (servicios de restauración en quioscos, food trucks e instalaciones móviles análogas) o 677.9 (venta ambulante sin elaboración) — la elección la valida tu gestor según si elaboras el producto en el vehículo o sólo lo vendes
cadenas.propuesta_en: The EIN is free from the IRS and you need one if you have employees or a multi-member LLC. Register for sales tax with your state before your first sale and ask whether you file monthly or quarterly. Keep a resale certificate for tax-free purchases of items you resell.
Register as an employer (state withholding, unemployment insurance and workers' comp)

cadenas.es: Cuota según la base mínima del tramo que te corresponda. Consulta el importe del ejercicio en curso y verifica con tu gestoría si te aplica la cuota reducida de inicio de actividad
cadenas.propuesta_en: Registration steps and unemployment insurance rates vary by state: confirm them with your state workforce agency and your accountant before your first payroll
Required in most cities, and some issue it online. If you trade under another name, file a DBA. The mobile vending license comes in Phase 2.
Keep business and personal money separate

cadenas.es: El Registro General Sanitario estatal NO aplica al minorista que sirve al consumidor final (art. 2.2 del RD 191/2011): el que te toca es el autonómico, el mismo que pide la fase 2 de este checklist con la autorización sanitaria del vehículo
cadenas.propuesta_en: For a food truck the permit is the mobile food unit permit, which comes after plan review (see Phase 2). Ask your county or city health department what it needs before you build. UK: register your food business with the council at least 28 days before you start (free; use the council where the vehicle is kept).
Events and landlords often require 1M per occurrence. Ask your insurance agent for certificates of insurance, which events will ask you to provide.

cadenas.es: Art. 30 del RGPD y art. 31 de la LOPDGDD: lo pide la AEPD en la primera inspección. Incluye clientes del programa de fidelización, personal y proveedores
cadenas.propuesta_en: Collecting emails, phone numbers or text consent for a loyalty program brings privacy duties: post a simple privacy notice, get TCPA consent before you text, and keep a record of what you collect and where it is stored. Covers loyalty members, staff and suppliers.

cadenas.propuesta_en: A truck often sells in several cities or counties with different rates. Choose a POS that applies the right rate by location and exports reports for your sales tax return, before you buy the tablet and card reader budgeted on the Startup Costs tab: switching later is expensive.

Build out the truck for cooking
Service window, counter, plumbing and electrical installations. The layout has to match the plans you submit to the health department.
Propane system inspection and fire marshal sign-off (if you cook with propane)
Many cities send the fire marshal before the health inspection (propane, extinguishers, suppression); NFPA 96 applies where adopted. Re-inspection is often annual.

cadenas.es: Obligatorio si se modifica la carrocería
cadenas.propuesta_en: Register the vehicle in the state where you will keep it. Bring the title or bill of sale and proof of insurance; some states require an inspection after structural modifications.

cadenas.es: Planos de instalación, flujos y depósitos de agua
cadenas.propuesta_en: Equipment layout, workflow and water tank drawings: most health departments review them before you build.
Mobile food unit permit and health inspection

Inspection of the finished, equipped truck. UK: the council inspects and gives you a Food Hygiene Rating (0-5) in your first months in England, Wales and Northern Ireland; Scotland uses FHIS (Pass / Improvement Required).
City mobile vending license (one per city)
Every city has its own rules. A license is not transferable between cities and each truck needs its own. UK: street trading licence or consent from each council where you sell.

cadenas.es: Muchos mercados tienen lista de espera

Driver's license class (CDL at 26,001 lb GVWR or more, or for a heavy truck-and-trailer combination)

Federal rule (49 CFR 383.91): a CDL is required for a single vehicle rated 26,001 lb GVWR or more, or for a combination rated 26,001 lb or more when the trailer is rated over 10,000 lb (Class A). Below that, most trucks need only a regular license; check with your state DMV, which may add its own rules.

cadenas.es: 4. Todas las cifras van SIN IVA. Para pasar un PVP a precio sin IVA, divide por el tipo que le corresponda: entre 1,10 en sala (comida y bebida, alcohol incluido: art. 91.Uno.2.2.º de la Ley 37/1992 del IVA) y, cuando se venden para llevar, los alimentos —bollería y pastelería incluidas—, que son productos alimenticios al tipo reducido por el art. 91.Uno.1.1.º; y entre 1,21 el tipo general, que en hostelería sólo alcanza a lo que sale del local como entrega de bienes excluida del reducido: el alcohol y los refrescos o zumos con azúcares añadidos para llevar o a domicilio (la comida para llevar sigue al 10 %); el libro lo aplica al alcohol del canal de delivery. El tipo de cada línea de venta está en la columna «Tipo de IVA de la línea» del P&L y de ahí salen los cobros, el IVA repercutido y el PVP equivalente. El IVA de la inversión se adelanta y se recupera con el modelo 303.
cadenas.en_actual: 4. All figures are EXCL. SALES TAX. To turn a menu price into a price excl. sales tax, divide it by 1 + your sales tax rate (with an 8% rate, divide by 1.08); if an item is taxed at a different rate (alcohol to go, for instance), use that rate. The rate of each sales line is in the "Sales tax rate on the line (%)" column of the P&L, and from it come the receipts, the sales tax collected and the equivalent menu price incl. sales tax. With the default 0% recoverable input tax, the sales tax you pay on purchases and startup costs is treated as a cost; in the UK, enter 20% if you are VAT-registered.
